empress-market.name: Empress Market
empress-market.price_text: Free to enter · small tips for photos
empress-market.hours: Roughly 06:00–20:00 daily · busiest early morning · check on the day
empress-market.tip: Go before 09:00 to see the produce halls at full swing and get the best light on the stone arches.

biryani.name: Karachi biryani lunch
biryani.price_text: ≈ PKR 250–600 a plate depending on the place
biryani.hours: Most biryani spots open around 11:00 and sell out by late afternoon
biryani.tip: Order a plate of chicken biryani with raita and ask for extra shorba; eat it hot at the counter.

go-aish.name: Go Aish
go-aish.price_text: Per-activity tickets; check current prices at the gate
go-aish.hours: Usually open afternoons into evening · confirm on the day
go-aish.tip: It is an outdoor adventure park above the coast; go late afternoon when it is cooler and bring a light jacket for the breeze.

indus-river.name: Indus River viewpoint
indus-river.tip: The river is far outside the city centre; treat it as a half-day trip and arrange a car and driver rather than relying on a quick stop.

sindbad.name: Sindbad Amusement Parks
sindbad.price_text: Entry plus ride tickets; check prices at the gate
sindbad.hours: Generally open afternoons and evenings · confirm on the day
sindbad.tip: A family-friendly park with rides; go on a weekday evening to avoid the biggest queues.

clifton-beach.name: Clifton Beach (Sea View)
clifton-beach.price_text: Free · camel and horse rides cost extra
clifton-beach.tip: Come at sunset for the crowds and camel rides, but keep valuables close and stay near the main promenade.

do-darya.name: Do Darya seafood strip
do-darya.price_text: ≈ PKR 1,500–4,000 per person depending on the restaurant
do-darya.hours: Most restaurants open around noon and run late into the night
do-darya.tip: Pick a restaurant with outdoor seating right on the water and order grilled fish; book ahead on weekend evenings.

mohatta-palace.name: Mohatta Palace Museum
mohatta-palace.hours: Usually Tue–Sun daytime · closed Monday · confirm on the day
mohatta-palace.tip: A pink-stone palace with rotating art exhibitions; combine it with a walk around the leafy old Clifton lanes nearby.

frere-hall.name: Frere Hall and gardens
frere-hall.price_text: Free to walk the gardens; small fee for some exhibitions
frere-hall.hours: Gardens open daily daytime · hall hours vary · check on the day
frere-hall.tip: A colonial-era hall with a peaceful garden; go in the morning for shade and quiet.

saddar-walk.name: Saddar bazaar walk
saddar-walk.price_text: Free · bring small cash for snacks and shopping
saddar-walk.tip: Wander the crowded lanes for textiles, spices and street snacks; keep bags in front of you and agree prices before buying.

tariq-road.name: Tariq Road shopping street
tariq-road.tip: Good for clothes and shoes at fixed-price shops; go on a weekday to avoid the crush.

boat-basin.name: Boat Basin food street
boat-basin.tip: A lively strip of cafes and grill restaurants; come hungry and try the BBQ and karahi.

empress-food.name: Empress Market meat and spice hall
empress-food.price_text: Free to browse · pay for what you buy
empress-food.tip: The inner halls are a working market, not a tourist site; ask before taking photos of vendors.

city-tour.name: Half-day guided city tour
city-tour.price_text: ≈ PKR 4,000–9,000 per person depending on group size
city-tour.tip: A driver-guide is the easiest way to cover Saddar, Clifton and the coast in one go; confirm what is included before booking.

port-grand.name: Karachi Port and harbour views
port-grand.tip: View the working port from the waterfront roads; access to the docks themselves is restricted.

seaview-park.name: Sea View park promenade
seaview-park.tip: A breezy walk along the seafront; go early morning for joggers and fewer crowds.

dha-phase8.name: DHA Phase 8 seafront walk
dha-phase8.tip: A quieter stretch of coast with cafes nearby; good for an evening stroll away from the main beach crowds.

burns-road.name: Burns Road food street
burns-road.tip: An old food street for nihari, haleem and sweets; go with someone who knows the stalls and eat where it is busy.

gulshan-park.name: Gulshan-e-Iqbal neighbourhood walk
gulshan-park.tip: A busy residential district with local cafes and markets; best explored with a local guide.

national-museum.name: National Museum of Pakistan
national-museum.hours: Usually Tue–Sun daytime · closed Monday · confirm on the day
national-museum.tip: Covers the Indus Valley and Islamic history; allow an hour and go in the cooler part of the day.

mazar-e-quaid.name: Mazar-e-Quaid
mazar-e-quaid.price_text: Free · small fee for some areas
mazar-e-quaid.tip: The white marble mausoleum is a calm, photogenic stop; dress modestly and remove shoes where required.

clifton-shopping.name: Clifton shopping and cafes
clifton-shopping.tip: An easy area for an air-conditioned afternoon of shops and cafes when the heat peaks.
